title_cyr: Не се бели Маре мори не се црви
title_latin: Ne se beli Mare mori ne se crvi
title_en: Don’t powder your face, Mare, don’t put on rouge

lines.cyr: Не се бели, Маре мори, не се црви,
lines.lat: Ne se beli, Mare mori, ne se crvi,
lines.en: Don’t powder your face, Mare, don’t put on rouge,
Don’t, Mare, don’t dress up so much.

lines.cyr: Ми се смеат, Маре мори, ергените,
lines.lat: Mi se smeat, Mare mori, ergenite,
lines.en: The bachelors laugh at me, Mare,

lines.cyr: Кого си го, Маре мори, погледнала,
lines.lat: Kogo si go, Mare mori, poglednala,
lines.en: Whom have you looked at, Mare,

lines.cyr: Кому два дни, Маре мори, кому три дни,
lines.lat: Komu dva dni, Mare mori, komu tri dni,
lines.en: To some for two days, Mare, to some for three days,

lines.cyr: а на мене Маре три години.
lines.lat: a na mene Mare tri godini.
lines.en: But to me, Mare, for three years.

lines.cyr: Ти ме стори, Маре мори, суво дрво,
lines.lat: Ti me stori, Mare mori, suvo drvo,
lines.en: You’ve made me, Mare, a dry tree,
A dry tree, Mare, a maple tree.

lines.cyr: Земи оган, Маре мори, запали ме,
lines.lat: Zemi ogan, Mare mori, zapali me,
lines.en: Take kindling, Mare, and light me up,
Set me on fire, Mare, and burn me.
